title: [BUG] Claude 0.2.91+ crashes with "ERROR Could not locate the bindings file."
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: `0.2.91 (Claude Code)`
- Operating System: macOS 15.0, Apple M1 Max
- Terminal:  iTerm2

I'm unable to use claude code now at all.

I've tried re-installing better-sqlite3 with bun and npm, and upgrading bun and reinstalling claude code, nothing helps.

top_comments.author: wolffiex
top_comments.body:
Hi, sorry but we don't really support running claude code with bun right now, so this isn't part of test matrix.
I'll see what we can do to support this configuration.

top_comments.author: wolffiex
top_comments.body: Ok, I think we will be able to address this in our next version. Stay tuned.

top_comments.author: wolffiex
top_comments.body: Ok thanks for these reports. The new version [v0.2.93](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/v/0.2.93) should work with Bun. For folks having trouble with Node, can you please post an example stacktrace?
